# The Casino & The Church

> A pixel RPG on Solana devnet, played on a MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollup. Crypto's two cultures are two realms: the
> Casino (LUCK, games) and the Church (FAITH, tithes, quests, campaigns). Staying in one drains the other, so balance
> is survival. Every bet settles on the rollup in about a second with no wallet popup; every outcome comes from
> MagicBlock VRF; a BTC UP/DOWN market is priced from Pyth Lazer; two AI hosts on NEAR AI Cloud run the house with
> signed decisions anchored on Solana. Play money only.

Live game: https://casino-and-church-mb.vercel.app
Program: 6uoz1h2ZWQMgniDx2vKEvh6bHtgCoFoGegfVtNW1q6cX (Solana devnet); rollup https://devnet-eu.magicblock.app
API health: https://server-production-41bf466c.up.railway.app/healthz
Start here: AGENT_README.md (what was built, claim-to-code map), then AGENTS.md (step-by-step testing guide)

## Quick start for agents

- Offline demo, no account, straight into the world: https://casino-and-church-mb.vercel.app/?demo=1&agent=1
- Open one place directly: add &play=<place>, e.g. https://casino-and-church-mb.vercel.app/?demo=1&agent=1&play=market
- Real on-chain game: https://casino-and-church-mb.vercel.app/?agent=1, press PLAY, sign in with Privy (email or
  social), choose a name and a character. 30 welcome bonus chips arrive in a few seconds.

URL parameters: agent=1 (no splash, no backstory, no tours, no music) · demo=1 (offline demo) · play=<place>.

## Moving without the canvas

Every panel is HTML. Use the Places button (map icon, #btn-places) or the page API:

- cnc.state(): mode, signedIn, profile, realm, chips, bonus, luck, faith, panelOpen, panelTitle
- cnc.places(): every location as {id, kind, label, realm}
- cnc.go('<place>'): go there and open it
- cnc.close(): close the open panel (Escape does too)

Places: cashier, slots-west, slots-east, wheel, market (BTC), blackjack, roulette, coinflip, dice, plot-1..3, monitor,
npc-owner (Don Fortuna), harmony, board, altar, missions, candles, offering, confessional, ledger, commission,
npc-priest (Father Nakamoto). Aliases: btc, don, priest, desk, quests.

Panels: #modal .gm[role=dialog], title in .gm-title span. Results: #res[role=status], with VIEW ON EXPLORER and
VERIFY THIS BET on the live game. Toasts: #toasts[role=log].

## Facts worth knowing

- 1 chip = 0.001 SOL. Casino bets are 10 chips. Cashier: GET FREE TEST SOL, then BUY CHIPS; CASH OUT returns SOL.
- Bonus chips (welcome, wheels, quests, alms) are spent first and can't be cashed out; what they win is real.
- BTC Exchange: 1-minute rounds, 1.9x on the right call, a tie refunds; a round with no fresh price is voided and refunded.
- Quest Board: a book, one quest per page. Commission Desk: campaigns lock their rewards up front (at least 500, 1,000
  or 200 chips for social, project or machine), run 1 to 30 days, and refund what isn't won.
- AI hosts decide every 10 minutes; each decision is signed in a TEE and its hash written on Solana (verify on the board).
- Run locally: pnpm install && pnpm dev (offline demo with placeholder art); pnpm test runs every test suite.
